// Room "P3 hall" (interior designer's part): entry hall, box x55..57 z14..20, floor layer y1, feet y2..4.
// The stair flight at x55 z15..17 is the joiner's and is not touched. The centre column x56 stays clear at feet
// level from the front door (56,14) to the back wall, so the door's lane reads straight through the hall.
// Focal piece: the console (barrel + potted poppy) against the back wall, where the doorway looks.
// Furniture: coat rack by the door (57,14), hall runner carpet, two hanging lanterns down the centre line.
import { layers, B } from "/Volumes/ext1/swe/repos/minecraft-design/tools/src/build.mjs";
import { coatRack } from "../vocab.mjs";

export function build(g) {
  // the coat rack beside the door's first cell (56,14), its banner turned into the hall
  coatRack(g, { x: 57, y: 2, z: 14, facing: "south", color: "brown", wood: "spruce" });

  // feet level (y2): a hall runner down the centre lane, and the console's barrel at the back wall
  // rows run along +z from z14; columns are x55, x56, x57
  layers(g, [55, 2, 14], { r: "brown_carpet", b: "barrel" }, [
    [
      "...", // z14: the door's first cell stays clear
      ".r.", // z15
      ".r.", // z16
      ".r.", // z17
      ".r.", // z18
      ".r.", // z19
      ".b.", // z20: the console
    ],
  ]);

  // the console's top (y3): a potted poppy on the barrel
  layers(g, [55, 3, 14], { p: "potted_poppy" }, [
    ["...", "...", "...", "...", "...", "...", ".p."],
  ]);

  // hanging lanterns down the centre line, from the ceiling block at y5 (oak planks above each)
  g.set(56, 4, 15, ...B.lantern(true));
  g.set(56, 4, 18, ...B.lantern(true));
}

set -e

node build.mjs build.nbt.tmp
mv build.nbt.tmp build.nbt
